text:
Windows Titlebar Blur Customizer is a free, open-source Windows desktop customization tool that transforms standard application title bars with beautiful Aero, Acrylic, Mica, and glass blur effects. Personalize the Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktop appearance without needing command-line knowledge.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Windows Titlebar Blur Customizer 4.4.2.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Windows Titlebar Blur Customizer 4.4.2.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Windows Titlebar Blur Customizer 4.4.2.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

- 🌫️ Advanced DWM Blur Effects — Customize Windows Desktop Window Manager title bar rendering with configurable blur and transparency effects.
- 🪟 Aero Glass Transparency — Bring back the classic Windows Aero appearance with glass-like surfaces, reflections, and visual depth.
- 🎨 Acrylic Material Effects — Apply modern translucent Acrylic styling to supported application title bars.
- 💎 Windows 11 Mica Support — Enhance compatible Windows 11 applications with elegant Mica and Mica Alt material effects.
- 🖌️ Custom Colors and Opacity — Adjust title bar blending colors, text colors, transparency, and blur intensity to match your desktop theme.
- 🌗 Automatic Light and Dark Modes — Configure appearance behavior for light and dark Windows themes independently.
- ⚙️ Multiple Blur Methods — Choose between CustomBlur, AccentBlur, and SystemBackdrop rendering approaches.
- 🖥️ Global Title Bar Customization — Apply consistent visual styling across supported desktop applications.
- ✨ Enhanced Window Controls — Customize title bar button appearance, including classic-style button dimensions and glow effects.
- 🎭 Third-Party Theme Compatibility — Extend desktop personalization while retaining support for compatible Windows themes and customization tools.

 🖼️ Overview

Explore the visual capabilities of Windows Titlebar Blur Customizer.

 

 Available Windows Material Effects

 Effect Description Platform 
 --- --- --- 
 Aero Classic transparent glass appearance Windows 10 / 11 
 Blur Customizable background blur Windows 10 / 11 
 Acrylic Modern translucent material Windows 10 / 11 
 Mica Native Windows material styling Windows 11 
 Mica Alt Alternative Mica appearance Windows 11 
 Accent Blur Accent-based blur rendering Compatible systems 
 SystemBackdrop Windows system backdrop effects Compatible systems 

 Desktop Personalization

Create a consistent Windows appearance by combining title bar transparency, custom colors, blur intensity, and automatic theme switching.

Whether you prefer the classic Aero Glass aesthetic or the modern Windows 11 Mica design, the available customization options make it possible to create a desktop environment that matches your preferences.

 🚀 Usage

1. Install the application using the official release package and follow the installation instructions.
2. Open the configuration interface to access the available Windows title bar customization settings.
3. Choose a visual effect such as Blur, Aero, Acrylic, or Mica where supported.
4. Adjust appearance settings including blur intensity, blend colors, text colors, and transparency.
5. Configure theme behavior to match your preferred Windows light or dark appearance.
6. Apply your settings and inspect the appearance of supported application title bars.
7. Fine-tune your desktop until the visual style matches your preferred Windows theme.

 Compatibility

 Requirement Support 
 --- --- 
 Windows 10 Version 2004 and newer 
 Windows 11 Supported releases 
 Desktop Window Manager Required 
 Aero effects Supported configurations 
 Acrylic effects Supported configurations 
 Mica effects Windows 11 
 Third-party themes Compatible configurations 

 Note: Certain blur methods and material effects depend on the Windows build and application rendering implementation. Windows Insider builds and heavily customized environments may have additional compatibility limitations.

 🎨 Customization Ideas

 Classic Aero Glass Desktop
Recreate the familiar transparent Windows appearance using glass blur, reflections, and custom blending colors.

 Modern Windows 11 Desktop
Use Mica-inspired materials and subtle transparency to complement the Windows 11 interface.

 Minimal Dark Theme
Combine dark title bar colors, restrained blur, and automatic dark-mode switching for a consistent desktop.

 Personalized Application Appearance
Adjust title bar colors and transparency to coordinate supported applications with your preferred wallpaper and desktop theme.

 🔧 Technical Overview

The application works with Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) to customize the appearance of supported window title bars.

Its customization approach provides options for different rendering methods rather than relying exclusively on the application's own visual settings.

Key technical capabilities include:

- Custom blur rendering methods.
- Windows accent-based blur integration.
- System backdrop effect support.
- Configurable title bar material appearance.
- Light and dark theme behavior.
- Compatibility considerations for legacy desktop applications.

The application does not aim to replace the rendering engine of individual programs. Its purpose is to provide system-level visual customization while preserving normal application functionality wherever supported.

 🔒 Security

Your Windows desktop customization should remain transparent and trustworthy.

- Open Source: The source code can be inspected and independently reviewed.
- No Telemetry: No built-in analytics or behavioral tracking is required for the application's customization features.
- No Account Required: Desktop personalization does not require creating an online account.
- Official Downloads: Obtain release packages through the project's official GitHub Releases page.
- Issue Repor
